name: Oath of Moment: Panoply of Old (Raven Guard)
description: Though every Blackshield has cast away the oaths that once bound them, some retained the wargear of their Legion. These relics of the Great Crusade would no longer be used to fight for the glory of the Primarchs, but for the bitter grudges of the cast-out. A Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule may make use of Wargear upgrades from a single Legion Armoury. For each Detachment with this Oath of Moment, the Controlling Player must select a single Legion Trait. All Units in that Detachment may make use of any Armoury of the Legion Wargear upgrades. This does not include any Rules or options from the chosen Legion’s Rites of War or any Prime Advantages – only options which replace Wargear. For the purposes of selecting Wargear upgrades only, all Models in the Detachment for which this Oath of Moment is selected are considered to have the Faction Trait of Legion chosen as part of this Oath of Moment. Legion chosen: Raven Guard. Options a Legion adds to the shared Legion wargear lists are not included.

corvid-pattern-jump-pack.name: Corvid Pattern Jump Pack
corvid-pattern-jump-pack.text: Any Model from the following list with the Raven Guard Trait may have one Corvid pattern jump pack selected for it for +10 Points per Model. Praetor with Jump Pack Centurion with Jump Pack Optae with Jump Pack Moritat A Model with a Corvid pattern jump pack has their Movement Characteristic set to 14 and replaces any instance of the Bulky (X) Special Rule with Bulky (3). Each time a Dangerous Terrain Test is made for a Model with a Corvid pattern jump pack, that Test is automatically passed.

raven-guard-corvid-pattern-jump-pack.name: Corvid Pattern Jump Pack
raven-guard-corvid-pattern-jump-pack.description: Any Praetor with Jump Pack, Centurion with Jump Pack, Optae with Jump Pack or Moritat with the Raven Guard Trait may have one Corvid pattern jump pack selected for it (Movement 14).

raven-guard-ravens-talons-pair-of-lightn.name: Pair of Raven’s Talons
raven-guard-ravens-talons-pair-of-lightn.description: Any Model with the Command Sub-Type and the Raven Guard Trait may have its lightning claw exchanged for one Raven’s Talon, or its pair of lightning claws exchanged for one pair of Raven’s Talons.
